subject.title: Feature: Add costCurrency config option to customize cost display currency

question: Should OpenClaw expand configured model cost estimates beyond USD, and if so should currency live per model, per provider, globally, or only as a display preference?
rationale: The request changes a high-bar config surface and touches cost accounting, persisted/session field names, status output, usage dashboards, docs, and USD telemetry, so code cannot safely choose the permanent contract on its own.

options.title: Define currency contract first
options.body: Choose scope and semantics before implementation so display, aggregation, persisted fields, and docs stay consistent.

options.title: Keep model costs USD-only
options.body: Leave configured model costs as USD estimates and treat non-USD local prices as unsupported until maintainers want a broader accounting change.

options.title: Add display-only symbol
options.body: Implement a narrow symbol formatter while explicitly preserving USD-like stored values and accepting mixed-currency ambiguity.

recommendation.title: Define currency contract first
recommendation.body: Choose scope and semantics before implementation so display, aggregation, persisted fields, and docs stay consistent.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the central usage cost reporting paths and is the strongest history-based owner for deciding whether the USD contract should change.
